# apim_dictionary (Resource)

Dictionary Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apim_dictionary" "dynamic" {
  hrid        = "dynamic"
  name        = "[Terraform] Dynamic dictionary"
  description = "Expose all headers of Gravitee echo API as properties"
  deployed    = true
  type        = "DYNAMIC"
  dynamic = {
    provider = {
      http = {
        type   = "HTTP"
        url    = "https://api.gravitee.io/echo"
        method = "GET"
        # This header will be returned and then used
        # as a property in the API policy
        headers = [
          {
            name  = "X-Test-Specific"
            value = "ABCDEF"
          }
        ]
        specification = <<-EOT
        [
          {
            "operation": "shift",
            "spec": {
              "headers": {
                "*": {
                  "$": "[#2].key",
                  "@": "[#2].value"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        ]
        EOT
      }
    }
    trigger = {
      rate = 5
      unit = "SECONDS"
    }
  }
}

variable "api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Requires APIM 4.13.2 or later
resource "apim_dictionary" "manual" {
  hrid     = "manual"
  name     = "[Terraform] Manual dictionary"
  deployed = true
  type     = "MANUAL"
  manual = {
    properties = {
      env = "production"
    }
    # Stored encrypted by APIM; from 4.13.3, a read returns it masked
    encrypted_properties = {
      "api-key" = {
        value = var.api_key
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployed` (Boolean) If true, a `MANUAL` type dictionary is deployed in the gateway, a `DYNAMIC` type dictionary is started. 
Changing this value back to false will stop the dictionary or undeploy it.
- `hrid` (String) A unique human readable id identifying this resource. Requires replacement if changed.
- `name` (String) Display name of the dictionary
- `type` (String) Type of dictionary. MANUAL is to be updated manually, DYNAMIC is updated and deployed automatically. must be one of ["MANUAL", "DYNAMIC"]

### Optional

- `description` (String) Detailed description of the dictionary
- `dynamic` (Attributes) A dynamic dictionary populated from an external provider on a schedule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dynamic))
- `environment_id` (String) environment ID
- `manual` (Attributes) A manual dictionary with static key/value properties. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manual))
- `organization_id` (String) organization ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource UUID.

<a id="nestedatt--dynamic"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dynamic`

Required:

- `provider` (Attributes) Provider of a 'DYNAMIC' type dictionary (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dynamic--provider))
- `trigger` (Attributes) Renewal configuration for a 'DYNAMIC' dictionary (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dynamic--trigger))

Optional:

- `encryption` (Attributes) Encryption of the values the provider fetches. Omitting it turns encryption off, so removing the block takes effect. Values already encrypted stay encrypted. Requires APIM 4.13.2 or later. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dynamic--encryption))

<a id="nestedatt--dynamic--provider"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dynamic.provider`

Optional:

- `http` (Attributes) HTTP dictionary provider configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dynamic--provider--http))

<a id="nestedatt--dynamic--provider--http"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dynamic.provider.http`

Optional:

- `body` (String) Optional request payload
- `headers` (Attributes List) HTTP Headers (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dynamic--provider--http--headers))
- `method` (String) Not Null; must be one of ["GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "HEAD", "OPTIONS", "TRACE", "CONNECT"]
- `specification` (String) Transformation of the returned payload (JOLT Specification). Not Null
- `type` (String) Type of dictionary provider. Not Null; must be "HTTP"
- `url` (String, Sensitive) URL of the provider. Not Null
- `use_system_proxy` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--dynamic--provider--http--headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dynamic.provider.http.headers`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Header name. Not Null
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Header value. Not Null




<a id="nestedatt--dynamic--trigger"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dynamic.trigger`

Required:

- `rate` (Number)
- `unit` (String) must be one of ["MICROSECONDS", "MILLISECONDS", "SECONDS", "MINUTES", "HOURS", "DAYS"]


<a id="nestedatt--dynamic--encryption"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dynamic.encryption`

Optional:

- `encrypt_on_fetch` (Boolean) Store every fetched value encrypted, from the first fetch. When false, APIM keeps each key's stored classification: a value already encrypted stays encrypted. Default: false



<a id="nestedatt--manual"></a>
### Nested Schema for `manual`

Optional:

- `encrypted_properties` (Attributes Map) Secret properties, keyed by the property key. Terraform sends the values as plaintext and APIM stores them encrypted. Terraform keeps the configured values in its state: a secret key added or removed outside Terraform plans a change, but a value changed outside Terraform is not detected. Removing a key, or the attribute, deletes the secret. A key must not appear in both `properties` and `encrypted_properties`. To make a secret plain again, remove it from `encrypted_properties` and apply, then add it to `properties` and apply. Requires APIM 4.13.2 or later; earlier versions ignore this attribute and store nothing. From APIM 4.13.3, a read returns each key with its value masked, a value of `••••••••••••` keeps the value APIM stores for that key (for instance after an import), and a key APIM holds encrypted must be declared here: declaring it under `properties`, or moving it there in one apply, is rejected with `dictionary.property.encryptedToPlain`. APIM 4.13.2 keeps such a key encrypted instead, and Terraform then plans to add it to `properties` on every run. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manual--encrypted_properties))
- `properties` (Map of String) Plain properties, keyed by the property key. A key APIM holds encrypted is never among them.

<a id="nestedatt--manual--encrypted_properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `manual.encrypted_properties`

Optional:

- `value` (String, Sensitive) The plaintext to encrypt, or `••••••••••••` to keep the value APIM stores for this key. APIM rejects the mask for a key it does not hold encrypted with `dictionary.property.maskedValue`. Not Null

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apim_dictionary.dynamic
  id = jsonencode({
    environment_id  = "DEFAULT"
    hrid            = "dynamic"
    organization_id = "DEFAULT"
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apim_dictionary.dynamic '{"environment_id": "DEFAULT", "hrid": "dynamic", "organization_id": "DEFAULT"}'
```
